collect._comment: Applied (devtools) mobile throttling. Lighthouse's default simulation counts every framework chunk requested before first paint as an LCP dependency, which over-states LCP for Next.js App Router pages (observed LCP = FCP here).

assert._comment: script:size covers first-party bundles AND the Google Tag Manager container, and the 280KB budget predates GTM. Measured: homepage 299KB, heaviest page (/services/ad-operations, which carries the lifecycle and QA visualisations) 326KB; 124KB of each is the container googletagmanager.com serves, which next/script loads async after hydration. 350KB leaves roughly 23KB of headroom over the heaviest page, so real first-party growth still fails. third-party:size is asserted separately so container growth stays visible instead of hiding inside the total.
